selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed node1 runs RHEL 8.8 and captured its initial Nginx, SELinux, firewall, and listener state.

selected_evidence.requirement: Successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, Nginx listened on TCP 6700 through IPv4 and IPv6, and `http://$NODE_IP:6700/` returned HTTP 200 with the expected response body.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID `a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55`, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID `28b59953-1877-4a8b-b016-60bb9c2dc5c1`, and recovered system, Nginx, SELinux, firewall, listener, and HTTP state.
